title: first-contact data payload
description: Data payload for the first-contact Forge-native task (v0.1.0).

ticket_key.description: Forge ticket key. Null only when the input was missing entirely.

type.description: The {TYPE} token rendered into the subject and body, derived from ticket.integrationType.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation accompanying a non-ok status.

missing_fields.description: Ticket fields a human must fill in before this can send. Populated when status is needs_input.

prior_marker_at.description: Timestamp of the pre-existing marker comment, when status is already_sent.

live_thread.description: Set when the live-thread guard declined: the most recent inbound client message found for this POC. Sender is resolved via X-Original-Sender, so group-relayed client mail is attributed correctly.

at.description: ISO timestamp of the client's message.

mailbox.description: Which mailbox it was found in (di@ or edith@).

ts.description: Epoch ms, used only for picking the newest.

greeting_name.description: POC name used in the greeting line. Null means the bare 'Hello,' fallback was used.

gmail_thread_id.description: Gmail threadId of the sent message. Join key for inbound reply matching.

gmail_message_id.description: Gmail message id of the sent message.

gmail_mailbox.description: Mailbox that sent the message. Gmail thread/message ids are mailbox-scoped and are only valid within it.

rfc822_message_id.description: Globally unique RFC822 Message-ID. Mailbox- and provider-independent join key for inbound In-Reply-To/References.

marker_posted.description: Whether the idempotency marker comment landed. False with status=partial means a re-run could double-send.

triggered_by.description: Email of the human or scheduler that dispatched this run.
